ITEM 1 | Red bell pepper strips, glossy bright red, flat-cut slivers about 4-6 cm long and 0.5-1 cm wide, some curled at edges, lightly moist surface, scattered across the bowl's upper-middle area | 60
ITEM 2 | Green bell pepper strips, matte-to-slightly glossy bright green, thin slivers about 4-6 cm long and 0.5-1 cm wide, some curled, interspersed with red pepper, covering roughly a quarter of the bowl's contents | 55
ITEM 3 | Raw red onion slivers, pale purple-white with translucent edges, thin crescent-cut strands about 3-5 cm long, loosely layered, slightly moist, clustered mostly in the left and center of the bowl | 40
ITEM 4 | Shredded orange carrot, bright orange thin matchstick strands about 3-5 cm long, fine and slightly limp, scattered among the onion and peppers | 15
ITEM 5 | Pale white shredded cabbage-like strands, thin and crinkled, slightly translucent, soft and limp, sitting in a small pile at the lower-right of the bowl | 20
